subject: File section
notes: cite.py --check 13.4.3 'Within a class definition, the file section may be specified only in a factory definition or an instance definition, but not in a method definition.' -> OK §13.4.3 1); '...shall not be specified within an interface definition.' -> OK. Five halves, each verified: (a) program definition: BindFileSection over programUnit (every golden with an FD). (b) function definition: PROBE p5.cob (FUNCTION-ID FSFN with FILE-CONTROL + FD, WRITE then READ back, RETURNING) prints FN=ABC at --std 2023 and 2002. (c) factory / instance: OoDriver reparents the FACTORY / OBJECT data division into a synthetic programUnit so BindFileSection binds it; goldens conformance:cases/_unassigned/oo_factory_file and conformance:cases/_unassigned/oo_object_file run I-O on them. (d) method: DataBinder.Oo.cs line ~286 raises COBOL1519 citing §13.4.3 SR1; pinned by OoSpineTests.MethodMayNotOwnEnvOrFileSection_1519 (spec-derived expected diagnostic). (e) interface: interfaceDefinition grammar has no dataDivision (p7.cob: interface-level DATA DIVISION FILE SECTION -> COBOL0001, rejected) and a prototype method's FILE SECTION draws COBOL2272 via PrototypeUnitRules.ScreenBody e) plus COBOL1519 (p6.cob, both editions). Minor: the interface-level refusal is a generic parse error, not a named diagnostic (under-rejection is not at issue; source is rejected). || Editions (adjudicator): program-definition half at every edition (85, 2002, 2014, 2023); function / factory / instance / method / interface halves 2002, 2014, 2023 (those definitions are introduced by ISO/IEC 1989:2002) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Oo/OoDriver.cs#OoReparentClassData (kb/Work PB3154 replaced OoDriver.OoReparentClassData and OoReparentFactoryData with the one OoReparent: BindClassData reparents the FACTORY and OBJECT paragraphs' own environment and data divisions into their synthetic programUnits, so BindFileSection binds each half's FILE SECTION, and the class definition's own division is bound once by the class binder)
